subject: CedarPeak private deployment — licensing & support next steps
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: David Morales <david@cedarpeak.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: CedarPeak private deployment — licensing & support next steps

Hi David,

Great to meet you and the engineering team earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on cost assumptions for the private/VPC deployment:

Key takeaways from the call:
- Workload profile: primarily asynchronous document ingestion + extractive Q&A with peak bursts for nightly re-indexing. You expect ~400M tokens/month average, 1.2B tokens/month peak.
- Environments: 1 prod, 1 staging, 2 dev sandboxes (team-level), plus an on-prem DR environment — total 5 environments.
- SLOs: 95th pct latency target ~350ms for chat endpoints; batch jobs can run on spot capacity.

Pricing assumptions we used in the demo estimate (attached PDF):
- Licensing model: annual platform license + per-environment runtime fee (env-based slab) OR optional token-based variable to accommodate bursty usage.
- Unit economics shown: baseline pricing anchored at $1,800 / 1M tokens for hosted inference; private licensing targets $700–$1,200 / 1M tokens depending on committed token tiers + environment count.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 48h SLA), Premier (24/7, 4h P1 response), and Enterprise (SLA + white-glove onboarding).

Questions / asks for your procurement team (so we can firm up the proposal):
1) Can you confirm the expected committed tokens for a 12-month contract (average and peak)? A band is fine (e.g., 300–600M avg / 1–1.5B peak).
2) Which support tier do you anticipate? Premier or Enterprise are common for regulated workloads.
3) Is isolation per environment required (dedicated GPU pools per env) or would logical tenancy with VPC segmentation be sufficient?

Next steps I propose:
- David/procurement: confirm committed token band and preferred support tier.
- Redwood (Marissa): we'll iterate the attached estimate into a formal commercial term sheet once tokens & env isolation choices are confirmed.
- Tech deep-dive: schedule a short follow-up with our infra lead (30–45 min) to confirm PCI/SOC requirements for the DR site.

Attaching the initial estimate and a simple DAP (deployment acceptance plan) we reference during the call.

If agreeable, I’ll lock in a follow-up for Friday to review updated numbers.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf (summary of license slabs), dap-request.xlsx (environment and compliance checklist)

From: David Morales <david@cedarpeak.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@cedarpeak.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPeak private deployment — licensing & support next steps

Thanks Karthik — useful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Committed tokens: We can commit to a 12-month baseline of 450M tokens/month with a 1.2B/month peak safety buffer. We would want a pricing step-down if we exceed 1.5B sustained.
- Support: We lean Premier to start, but may require Enterprise for the DR/production cutover window.
- Isolation: We prefer dedicated GPU pools for prod and DR, logical tenancy for staging/dev.

Procurement asked for two things for the draft:
1) A worked example showing three pricing scenarios: conservative (450M avg), expected (650M avg), and aggressive (1.0B avg) with committed vs overage unit economics and target $/1M tokens.
2) A callout on the license topology: what changes if we add an additional sandbox environment later (pricing delta and lead time).

Can Marissa pick this up and send the scenarios? We’re targeting an internal review next Thursday.

—David
Director, Engineering — CedarPeak Labs

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Morales <david@cedarpeak.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CedarPeak private deployment — licensing & support next steps

David — looping in Priyom from Pricing. We’ll model the three scenarios David requested and include: committed discount bands, overage rates, and the incremental add-on cost for an extra sandbox environment. Quick notes to set expectations: 

- Target unit economics: for private deployments with dedicated GPU pools we typically target $900–$1,100 / 1M tokens at the 500–700M committed tier; larger commits (>=1B/month) push us towards $650–$800 / 1M.
- Overage: typically billed at 120% of committed unit price until we re-baseline.
- Additional sandbox env: provisioning lead time ~2–3 weeks; nominal licensing delta $8k–$12k / month for a GPU-backed sandbox, or $1.2k/month for a logically-tenanted sandbox.

Priyom — can you produce a simple three-scenario worksheet and a one-pager that calls out the env-add delta? We’ll attach both to the HubSpot deal and update the Drive link.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: David Morales <david@cedarpeak.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing scenarios + next steps (attached worksheets)

David / team — attached is a short worksheet with the three scenarios (conservative/expected/aggressive) plus worked math for $/1M tokens at committed tiers and overage bands. Highlights:

- Conservative (450M avg): committed unit = $1,050 / 1M tokens; expected monthly cost ~ $472.5k; overage rate = $1,260 / 1M.
- Expected (650M avg): committed unit = $850 / 1M tokens; expected monthly cost ~ $552.5k; overage rate = $1,020 / 1M.
- Aggressive (1.0B avg): committed unit = $680 / 1M tokens; expected monthly cost ~ $680k; overage rate = $816 / 1M.

Environment delta (prod/dedicated, DR/dedicated, staging/logical, 2x dev/logical):
- Add sandbox (dedicated GPU): +$10k/month (2–3 week lead).
- Logical sandbox: +$1.2k/month (near-immediate).

Ask: if procurement confirms the 450M committed baseline we can post a term sheet with Premier support and the licensing topology that reflects dedicated prod/DR + logical staging/dev. If they prefer a flexible token overlay (to smooth bursts) we can include a blended committed+variable quote.

I’ve attached dap-request.xlsx and a short one-pager; redwood-pricing-estimate.pdf contains the full slab breakdown.

Next alignment call: I propose Tues 2027-05-04 10:00 AM PDT — would that work for your team?

-Priyom
Principal Pricing Analyst | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: pricing-scenarios.xlsx, env-delta-onepager.pdf
